headline: St. Thomas Aquinas have lost only outside their conference
dek: St. Thomas Aquinas beat Mercy again and have won every match since Millersville beat them. All four of their defeats came against Millersville and Northeast-10 sides, and no East Coast Conference rival has taken more than a draw from them.
